title: SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 released at ssc.gov.in, raise objection till Nov 7 - Business Standard

 Home / Education / News / SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 released at ssc.gov.in, raise objection till Nov 7 SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 released at ssc.gov.in, raise objection till Nov 7
 SSC has released the SSC CGL Tier I Answer Key 2026 on the official website. Candidates who appeared for the Combined Graduate Level Examination 2026 can download the provisional key
 SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 Out
 Princess Sonika New Delhi 3 min read Last Updated : Nov 05 2026 | 11:35 AM IST Listen to This Article
 The SSC CGL Tier I Answer Key 2026 has been made available by the Staff Selection Commission (SSC). The preliminary key is available for download on the SSC's official website, ssc.gov.in, for candidates who took the Combined Graduate Level Examination, 2026 (Tier-I).   Additionally, the opportunity for objections has opened; the deadline for objecting to the answer key is November 7, 2026. Candidates must pay ₹50 for each question or answer that is contested in order to raise an objection. SSC CGL Tier I Answer Key 2026: How to raise objections? 
 Visit the official website of SSC at ssc.gov.in.   Click on the login link available on the home page.     A new page will display where candidates will have to fill in the login details. Also Read

   The answer key will be showcased.   Check the answer key and choose the answer you want to raise objection for.   Upload the supporting documents.   Make the payment of the processing fee and click on submit.   Download the confirmation page and keep a hard copy of the same for later.   ALSO READ:  JEE Main 2027: NTA allows NRI candidates to use passport as valid ID proof Details Mentioned in SSC CGL Answer Key 2026
 Candidate's Name   Roll Number   Registration Number   Examination Name   Exam Date and Shift   Question Paper   Question ID   Correct Answer   Candidate's Recorded Response   Marks Obtained   Answer Key Status   Objection Submission Link. About SSC CGL Tier I Answer Key 2026
 The dates of the Tier I exam were set for September 30, 2026, to October 30, 2026. The Tier I test consisted of 100 questions for 200 marks. The exam lasted for one hour. Multiple-choice, objective-type questions made up Tier I.   With the exception of English comprehension, the questions were presented in both Hindi and English. 12,256 positions in the company will be filled by this recruitment campaign. Candidates can visit the SSC's official website for further information.   ALSO READ:  SSC Exam Calendar 2026: 3 major exams will be held in November; know more More about the SSC CGL Tier I Answer Key 2026
 Candidates should be aware that the saved question paper is only intended for their own use and self-analysis. Candidates will see an undertaking to this effect when they log into the Challenge Management portal.   Additionally, candidates are encouraged to review the comprehensive rules for the Challenge/Objection Management System published on the Commission's website in a notification dated 10.04.2026.
